MAP_ABANDONED_SHIP_HIDDEN_FLOOR_CORRIDOR.name: AbandonedShip_HiddenFloorCorridors
MAP_ABANDONED_SHIP_HIDDEN_FLOOR_CORRIDOR.assessment: Frillish, Dragalge and Dhelmise make the submerged wreck distinct. Keep the deep-water preparation options and trace Dive access separately from first boarding the ship.

MAP_ABANDONED_SHIP_ROOMS_B1F.name: AbandonedShip_Rooms_B1F
MAP_ABANDONED_SHIP_ROOMS_B1F.assessment: Mareanie and the coastal predators fit the flooded rooms; Lapras gives an attractive optional return. Room access and rod ownership, not nominal table levels, control first use.

MAP_ALTERING_CAVE.name: AlteringCave
MAP_ALTERING_CAVE.assessment: Preserve the nine legacy selector tables as explicitly conditional data, with selector0 as the default. The expanded lower caves carry the active postgame diversity; do not count every selector as a normal simultaneous roster.

MAP_ALTERING_CAVE_1F.name: AlteringCave_1F
MAP_ALTERING_CAVE_1F.assessment: The broad postgame cave roster provides ready alternatives for exhibitions. Lucario, Spiritomb and Blissey have actual roles; high variety here is appropriate after a long campaign.

MAP_ALTERING_CAVE_B1F.name: AlteringCave_B1F
MAP_ALTERING_CAVE_B1F.assessment: Keep Guzzlord as the exceptional deep-cave find and distinguish its Sign capture limit from repeatable ordinary species. Fishing adds routes that are not implied by the land roster.

MAP_ARTISAN_CAVE_1F.name: ArtisanCave_1F
MAP_ARTISAN_CAVE_1F.assessment: Smeargle deserves stronger visual and dialogue identity, but preserve the useful broad collection. Its13% leading slot is a conscious broad-access choice rather than a broken probability. No automatic return to a monotypic cave.

MAP_ARTISAN_CAVE_B1F.name: ArtisanCave_B1F
MAP_ARTISAN_CAVE_B1F.assessment: The matching upper-floor roster is acceptable collection convenience in this small postgame location. Preserve Smeargle access and improve guidance through the world chapter instead of arbitrary species churn.

MAP_ASHEN_WOODS.name: AshenWoods
MAP_ASHEN_WOODS.assessment: Fire-adapted wildlife and strong insects are convincing. Two redundant evolved birds yield space for Brute Bonnet and Bloodmoon Ursaluna; their original families retain much earlier acquisition paths.

changes.name: AshenWoods
changes.rationale: The ash forest gains an ancient mushroom. Pikipek remains on Route104 and evolves at14, so the Trumbeak family remains early and plentiful.
changes.authoring_dependency: For Route117 fishing add a validated optional two-species old_rod_species override to the existing route sheet/builder; all other entries are native land-table edits.
changes.acceptance: Reconcile configured species; preserve slot weights/levels and all other slots; ordinary-method chances >=5%; verify local encounter terrain/method access; check displaced-family remaining source before materializing.

changes.name: AshenWoods
changes.rationale: Add the otherwise unattainable Bloodmoon form as a distinctive forest discovery. Hoothoot is available on Route103/Dewford Manor and evolves at20; the existing bear family is preserved.
changes.authoring_dependency: For Route117 fishing add a validated optional two-species old_rod_species override to the existing route sheet/builder; all other entries are native land-table edits.
changes.acceptance: Reconcile configured species; preserve slot weights/levels and all other slots; ordinary-method chances >=5%; verify local encounter terrain/method access; check displaced-family remaining source before materializing.

MAP_CAVE_OF_ORIGIN_1F.name: CaveOfOrigin_1F
MAP_CAVE_OF_ORIGIN_1F.assessment: Carbink, mineral Pokémon and the unusual Walking Wake slot reinforce an exceptional story site. Preserve its powerful choices and the ordinary/legendary source distinctions.

MAP_CAVE_OF_ORIGIN_DIANCIES_ROOM.name: CaveOfOrigin_DianciesRoom
MAP_CAVE_OF_ORIGIN_DIANCIES_ROOM.assessment: The mixed supporting roster is broad rather than tightly mineral. Retain it while the explicit Diancie landmark, stone and restored Wallace exhibition establish the chamber's identity; avoid moving many useful families for cosmetic purity.

MAP_CAVE_OF_ORIGIN_ENTRANCE.name: CaveOfOrigin_Entrance
MAP_CAVE_OF_ORIGIN_ENTRANCE.assessment: The entrance provides cave residents before the deeper mineral/dragon discoveries. Keep the mix and treat story access as a separate requirement from species table levels.

MAP_CAVE_OF_ORIGIN_UNUSED_RUBY_SAPPHIRE_.name: CaveOfOrigin_UnusedRubySapphireMap1
MAP_CAVE_OF_ORIGIN_UNUSED_RUBY_SAPPHIRE_.assessment: Despite its legacy name, this is part of the expanded connected chamber sequence. Preserve mineral/dragon continuity and verify the actual warp route rather than excluding it by name.

MAP_CAVE_OF_ORIGIN_UNUSED_RUBY_SAPPHIRE_.name: CaveOfOrigin_UnusedRubySapphireMap2
MAP_CAVE_OF_ORIGIN_UNUSED_RUBY_SAPPHIRE_.assessment: The more evolved crystal/steel roster supports late team preparation. Preserve Archaludon and Goodra options and cross-reference reachable chamber progression.

MAP_CAVE_OF_ORIGIN_UNUSED_RUBY_SAPPHIRE_.name: CaveOfOrigin_UnusedRubySapphireMap3
MAP_CAVE_OF_ORIGIN_UNUSED_RUBY_SAPPHIRE_.assessment: Clefable, Metang and mineral residents suit the final approach to Diancie. Preserve the powerful late alternatives and the actual Diancie-room warp.

MAP_DESERT_UNDERPASS.name: DesertUnderpass
MAP_DESERT_UNDERPASS.assessment: Ditto, burrowers and reconstructed fossils make a useful secret route. Add the three-segment Dudunsparce in a redundant Espathra slot, with Flittle retaining that evolution. Preserve this unusual collection and its connection from Sandstrewn Ruins; the fossil-maniac entrance gate alone does not define earliest access.

changes.name: DesertUnderpass
changes.acceptance: Preserve all other slots/weights/levels; validate configured exact form, actual source access and retained displaced-family route.
changes.rationale: Provide three-segment Dudunsparce directly at5% in the burrowing habitat. Flittle remains here and preserves Espathra through evolution.

MAP_DEWFORD_MANOR_1F.name: DewfordManor_1F
MAP_DEWFORD_MANOR_1F.assessment: The abandoned captain's home gives early Ghost/Psychic choices without taking Duskull away from Mt.Pyre. Keep Mime Jr., Galarian Slowpoke and the broad haunted roster.

MAP_DEWFORD_MEADOW.name: DewfordMeadow
MAP_DEWFORD_MEADOW.assessment: Keep butterflies, redirection/support candidates and Pheromosa. Early power is intentional ammunition, not a reason for automatic delay; test the actual nearby battles rather than infer imbalance from rarity labels.

MAP_DEWFORD_TOWN.name: DewfordTown
MAP_DEWFORD_TOWN.assessment: Old Rod Mantyke40% is a direct low-cap success. Keep Magikarp60% beside it, the shore Rock Smash set and later Surf/fishing revisits as distinct acquisition methods.

MAP_EMBER_PATH.name: EmberPath
MAP_EMBER_PATH.assessment: Fire insects, furnace species and Blacephalon distinguish this hot optional passage. Preserve its exceptional encounter and the connection into Ashen Woods.

MAP_EVER_GRANDE_CITY.name: EverGrandeCity
MAP_EVER_GRANDE_CITY.assessment: Keep the final coastal preparation pool and the five-species Super Rod set. The Waterfall approach and actual shoreline access must be represented in acquisition guidance.

MAP_FIERY_PATH.name: FieryPath
MAP_FIERY_PATH.assessment: Numel-country heat, Torkoal, gas and Fire types remain recognizable. Replace only a redundant Larvesta occurrence with Slither Wing, retaining its earlier forest acquisition.

changes.name: FieryPath
changes.rationale: A sun-associated ancient insect gives the hot path a distinct find. Larvesta remains in the deeper Petalburg forest, Ashen Woods and volcanic interiors.
changes.authoring_dependency: For Route117 fishing add a validated optional two-species old_rod_species override to the existing route sheet/builder; all other entries are native land-table edits.
changes.acceptance: Reconcile configured species; preserve slot weights/levels and all other slots; ordinary-method chances >=5%; verify local encounter terrain/method access; check displaced-family remaining source before materializing.

MAP_GRANITE_CAVE_1F.name: GraniteCave_1F
MAP_GRANITE_CAVE_1F.assessment: Zubat, Geodude, Makuhita, Aron and Abra retain the original cave identity while Beldum and newer minerals expand choice. Preserve all12 entries and early high-ceiling options.

MAP_GRANITE_CAVE_B1F.name: GraniteCave_B1F
MAP_GRANITE_CAVE_B1F.assessment: Sableye/Mawile, Bronzor, Meditite and mineral residents give a distinct deeper roster. Keep the alternatives and separate darkness/physical navigation from battle availability.

MAP_GRANITE_CAVE_B2F.name: GraniteCave_B2F
MAP_GRANITE_CAVE_B2F.assessment: Duraludon, Deino and Tinkatink reward deeper exploration. Keep the ordinary table separate from Cobalion's landmark and Rock Smash access; neither is established by seeing a species in another method.

MAP_GRANITE_CAVE_STEVENS_ROOM.name: GraniteCave_StevensRoom
MAP_GRANITE_CAVE_STEVENS_ROOM.assessment: The steel/mineral roster makes Steven's chamber distinctive. Metang and Lucario are deliberate immediately strong options; retain them alongside their earlier forms.

MAP_JAGGED_PASS.name: JaggedPass
MAP_JAGGED_PASS.assessment: Fighting, Ground, Fire and mountain dragons fit the slopes. Preserve the broad roster and bike/path distinctions; no proposal delays early Bagon merely to enforce a growth chapter.

MAP_LILYCOVE_CITY.name: LilycoveCity
MAP_LILYCOVE_CITY.assessment: Coastal Surf and rod pools provide useful late options near preparation services. Keep Lapras and Relicanth access and distinguish fishing choices from nearby route grass.

MAP_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_1F.name: MagmaHideout_1F
MAP_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_1F.assessment: Numel, Slugma, stone and gas establish faction habitat immediately. Keep familiar residents and capable Fire/Ground choices during demanding story battles.

MAP_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_2F_1R.name: MagmaHideout_2F_1R
MAP_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_2F_1R.assessment: Noibat and evolved minerals vary the volcanic cave without losing Numel. Preserve the battle-ready reserve options rather than require raising only low forms.

MAP_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_2F_2R.name: MagmaHideout_2F_2R
MAP_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_2F_2R.assessment: The toxic pocket is distinguished by Koffing/Grimer and their support. Keep the Houndour/Salandit lines and the existing encounter levels under the global wild clamp.

MAP_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_2F_3R.name: MagmaHideout_2F_3R
MAP_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_2F_3R.assessment: The darker Fire roster complements the adjacent toxic chamber. Keep Houndour, Camerupt and Salazzle choices as practical alternatives to a single mandatory counter-team.

MAP_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_3F_1R.name: MagmaHideout_3F_1R
MAP_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_3F_1R.assessment: Evolved Fire threats are appropriate within the hideout's main confrontation. Preserve Darmanitan and Volcarona as optional player tools at the same time opponents use serious combinations.

MAP_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_3F_2R.name: MagmaHideout_3F_2R
MAP_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_3F_2R.assessment: The furnace-like chamber adds Chandelure and retains mixed offensive options. Same-family repetition supports convenient preparation rather than implying a required encounter rewrite.

MAP_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_3F_3R.name: MagmaHideout_3F_3R
MAP_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_3F_3R.assessment: This chamber retains unevolved Larvesta alongside developed Fire species. Keep the choice of immediate readiness or a preferred family; the Leveler removes level-grind pressure.

MAP_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_4F.name: MagmaHideout_4F
MAP_MAGMA_HIDEOUT_4F.assessment: The climax floor gains Gouging Fire by replacing one redundant Magmar occurrence. Magby/Magmar remain available elsewhere; Camerupt and the volcanic identity stay intact.

changes.name: MagmaHideout_4F
changes.rationale: Add a missing ancient fire species near the volcanic climax. Magby and Magmar remain in multiple earlier fire habitats.

MAP_METEOR_FALLS_1F_1R.name: MeteorFalls_1F_1R
MAP_METEOR_FALLS_1F_1R.assessment: Solrock/Lunatone, Bagon and rare mineral/dragon visitors make an excellent landmark roster. Preserve early Bagon elsewhere too; this site remains meaningful through density and its own discoveries.

MAP_METEOR_FALLS_1F_2R.name: MeteorFalls_1F_2R
MAP_METEOR_FALLS_1F_2R.assessment: Scream Tail replaces a repeated Clefairy occurrence while lunar anchors and Bagon stay. Rear-chamber physical access must not be conflated with first entry to the front cave.

changes.name: MeteorFalls_1F_2R
changes.rationale: Add the missing ancient lunar Fairy while retaining Clefairy in the front chamber and other Falls floors. Existing back-room physical access is retained.

MAP_METEOR_FALLS_B1F_1R.name: MeteorFalls_B1F_1R
MAP_METEOR_FALLS_B1F_1R.assessment: Preserve the mature dragons and metallic plants. Distinguish its land roster, water methods, and legendary landmark; Waterfall/path prerequisites are documented by the world route.

MAP_METEOR_FALLS_B1F_2R.name: MeteorFalls_B1F_2R
MAP_METEOR_FALLS_B1F_2R.assessment: Salamence, Dragonite and Roaring Moon make the remote chamber rewarding. Keep powerful ordinary discoveries and the Jirachi/Cresselia-related story paths separate.

MAP_METEOR_FALLS_STEVENS_CAVE.name: MeteorFalls_StevensCave
MAP_METEOR_FALLS_STEVENS_CAVE.assessment: The steel/stone collection gains Iron Boulder in a redundant Duraludon slot. Retain Metagross and Iron Crown, and keep Steven's authored team as a separate encounter obligation.

changes.name: MeteorFalls_StevensCave
changes.rationale: The deepest steel/stone collection gains a missing future mineral species. Duraludon retains Granite Cave, Route118 and other caves.

changes.acceptance: Reconcile configured species; preserve slot weights/levels and all other slots; ordinary-method chances >=5%; verify local encounter terrain/method access; check displaced-family remaining source before materializing.

MAP_MIRAGE_TOWER_1F.name: MirageTower_1F
MAP_MIRAGE_TOWER_1F.assessment: Sandshrew/Trapinch plus relic-like Ghost/Steel residents fit an archaeological entrance. Keep the meaningful fossil route and tower disappearance state distinct from catchable species.

MAP_MIRAGE_TOWER_2F.name: MirageTower_2F
MAP_MIRAGE_TOWER_2F.assessment: Cofagrigus-line, golems and burrowing species support the ascent. Preserve the varied counter-building options and check bike/obstacle access through the existing puzzle.

MAP_MIRAGE_TOWER_3F.name: MirageTower_3F
MAP_MIRAGE_TOWER_3F.assessment: Developed relic Pokémon make the upper floor feel deeper without withholding advanced strategy earlier. Keep its distinct Golurk/Claydol/Brongzong mix and stone interactions.

MAP_MIRAGE_TOWER_4F.name: MirageTower_4F
MAP_MIRAGE_TOWER_4F.assessment: The evolved ruin roster suits the fossil summit. Preserve it and ensure the permanent Sandstrewn/Underpass route still supports later collection after the tower event.

MAP_MIRAGE_TOWER_B1F.name: MirageTower_B1F
MAP_MIRAGE_TOWER_B1F.assessment: Gimmighoul Chest provides a distinctive subterranean find among relics. Keep the basement gateway and its field encounters separate from the temporary above-ground tower.

MAP_MOSSDEEP_CITY.name: MossdeepCity
MAP_MOSSDEEP_CITY.assessment: Finizen and marine support Pokémon fit a research island. Keep the rod/Surf split and convenient access to late-team options near the Space Center sequence.

MAP_MT_PYRE_1F.name: MtPyre_1F
MAP_MT_PYRE_1F.assessment: Shuppet and Duskull remain leading residents with familiar and modern Ghosts. Preserve the room as the clear entry into the Duskull family's dedicated habitat.

MAP_MT_PYRE_2F.name: MtPyre_2F
MAP_MT_PYRE_2F.assessment: The second floor keeps Shuppet/Duskull and spirit flora. An Antique Sinistea variant can replace this floor's ordinary Sinistea while phony cups remain in earlier sources.

changes.name: MtPyre_2F
changes.acceptance: Preserve all other slots/weights/levels; validate configured exact form, actual source access and retained displaced-family route.
changes.rationale: Add Antique Sinistea on a haunted upper route while phony Sinistea remains in Dewford Manor and other Mt.Pyre floors; the free Chipped Pot supports its evolution.

MAP_MT_PYRE_3F.name: MtPyre_3F
MAP_MT_PYRE_3F.assessment: Lampent and the original ghosts provide increasing local variety. Preserve the roster and the actual indoor trainer paths rather than use cosmetic floor numbers as capture gates.

MAP_MT_PYRE_4F.name: MtPyre_4F
MAP_MT_PYRE_4F.assessment: Mimikyu and Poltchageist broaden the tower's supernatural ecology. Keep all useful roles, including evolved ghosts available without a separate grinding requirement.

MAP_MT_PYRE_5F.name: MtPyre_5F
MAP_MT_PYRE_5F.assessment: The upper floor keeps the original Ghost families and can distinguish artisan Poltchageist from counterfeit forms below. Preserve all unrelated roster entries.

changes.name: MtPyre_5F
changes.acceptance: Preserve all other slots/weights/levels; validate configured exact form, actual source access and retained displaced-family route.
changes.rationale: Add artisan Poltchageist while counterfeit specimens remain on other haunted routes; the existing Masterpiece Teacup supports the resulting form.

MAP_MT_PYRE_6F.name: MtPyre_6F
MAP_MT_PYRE_6F.assessment: Sinistcha, Houndstone and the mature original Ghosts support final preparations. Keep the Pecharunt/Giratina landmarks as separately gated interactions.

MAP_MT_PYRE_EXTERIOR.name: MtPyre_Exterior
MAP_MT_PYRE_EXTERIOR.assessment: Vulpix, Meditite, Chimecho and unusual regional spirits preserve the familiar exterior identity. Keep Duskull here and distinguish exterior grass from internal ghost floors.

MAP_MT_PYRE_SUMMIT.name: MtPyre_Summit
MAP_MT_PYRE_SUMMIT.assessment: Flutter Mane is a powerful thematic discovery among spirits and mournful residents. Preserve it; the Darkrai NPC quest and relic story state require separate clear guidance.

MAP_NEW_MAUVILLE_ENTRANCE.name: NewMauville_Entrance
MAP_NEW_MAUVILLE_ENTRANCE.assessment: Magnemite/Voltorb/Klink establish the station. Iron Thorns replaces a redundant evolved Eelektross slot while Tynamo and its evolution path remain available locally.

changes.name: NewMauville_Entrance
changes.rationale: The power station gains a missing mechanical Electric species. Tynamo stays in the station and evolves through the free item archive; Magnemite/Voltorb/Klink identity remains.
changes.authoring_dependency: For Route117 fishing add a validated optional two-species old_rod_species override to the existing route sheet/builder; all other entries are native land-table edits.
changes.acceptance: Reconcile configured species; preserve slot weights/levels and all other slots; ordinary-method chances >=5%; verify local encounter terrain/method access; check displaced-family remaining source before materializing.

MAP_NEW_MAUVILLE_INSIDE.name: NewMauville_Inside
MAP_NEW_MAUVILLE_INSIDE.assessment: Keep technological families, Iron Hands and Wattrel. Rotom's scripted interaction, Meltan's landmark/evolution condition and ordinary encounters are distinct routes and must all be accurately explained.

MAP_PACIFIDLOG_TOWN.name: PacifidlogTown
MAP_PACIFIDLOG_TOWN.assessment: The floating settlement offers ocean support and predator choices. Keep Finizen, Lapras and rod-specific differences; currents determine which other habitats are reachable from here.

MAP_PETALBURG_CITY.name: PetalburgCity
MAP_PETALBURG_CITY.assessment: Pond encounters and coastal-like fishing provide convenient return options after Surf. Preserve the method diversity and avoid claiming these water species are all available on the initial visit.

MAP_PETALBURG_WOODS.name: PetalburgWoods
MAP_PETALBURG_WOODS.assessment: Preserve Shroomish/Slakoth/Wurmple with Caterpie, Ferroseed and the newly restored Burmy. This already meets broad early ammunition and woodland identity without another large reshuffle.

MAP_PETALBURG_WOODS_2.name: PetalburgWoods_2
MAP_PETALBURG_WOODS_2.assessment: Cocoons, bugs, elemental monkeys and forest fruits make a distinct deeper section. Keep Paras and its useful support moves; Cut/path access is an actual requirement, not a badge-list guess.

MAP_PETALBURG_WOODS_3.name: PetalburgWoods_3
MAP_PETALBURG_WOODS_3.assessment: Keep the diverse deep forest and early Kartana option. Its maze, optional water and Rock Smash methods make geography meaningful; dormant Hidden rows are not an extra native encounter method.

MAP_ROUTE101.name: Route101
MAP_ROUTE101.assessment: The opening has strong Hoenn anchors and baby/unevolved alternatives. Preserve its12-species roster around the new two-starter rescue and pre-rival catching loop.

MAP_ROUTE102.name: Route102
MAP_ROUTE102.assessment: Lotad/Seedot/Ralts/Surskit remain recognizable and Happiny/Togepi offer support choices. Preserve the roster so the first expert doubles battles have multiple available answers.

MAP_ROUTE103.name: Route103
MAP_ROUTE103.assessment: The Electric-rich roster is an intentional broad early resource after the user's clarification. Keep those options; improve the riverside identity through world context rather than an automatic availability nerf.

MAP_ROUTE104.name: Route104
MAP_ROUTE104.assessment: Mienfoo, babies, birds and plants give varied low-cap team-building. Preserve the eleven-percent Mienfoo and the fishing/Surf return layer independently of the initial woodland route.

MAP_ROUTE105.name: Route105
MAP_ROUTE105.assessment: The shoreline roster offers Water, Psychic and Fighting options. Verify actual grass/island access rather than assuming Briney's passage allows landing at every listed encounter tile.

MAP_ROUTE106.name: Route106
MAP_ROUTE106.assessment: Makuhita, Machop, coastal invertebrates and strong Fighting visitors suit Dewford's shore. Preserve Hawlucha/Falinks and the separate Rock Smash/capture methods.

MAP_ROUTE107.name: Route107
MAP_ROUTE107.assessment: The western shelf offers a distinct mix of fish and shallow-water species. Keep rod tiers and practical chances; boating past the route is not equivalent to Surf access.

MAP_ROUTE108.name: Route108
MAP_ROUTE108.assessment: Frillish, Dragalge and Dhelmise support the wreck-adjacent sea identity. Keep the shoreline fish pool and the Abandoned Ship connection as a worthwhile revisit.

MAP_ROUTE109.name: Route109
MAP_ROUTE109.assessment: The beach's Rock Smash pool includes Sandygast and Pincurchin, making a method-specific discovery worthwhile. Keep Surf and fishing availability separate from early beach trainer access.

MAP_ROUTE110.name: Route110
MAP_ROUTE110.assessment: Electrike, Gulpin, Plusle/Minun and urban newcomers establish the electrical corridor. Preserve the broad roster, including Pachirisu and Gimmighoul; resolve legendary clues without moving their gates.

MAP_ROUTE111.name: Route111
MAP_ROUTE111.assessment: Desert residents and Galarian Yamask fit the arid region. Retain Gible and other strong choices; the Dynamo rope, desert goggles and permanent cursed-stone path are separate physical requirements.

MAP_ROUTE111_RUINS_EXTERIOR.name: Route111_RuinsExterior
MAP_ROUTE111_RUINS_EXTERIOR.assessment: The plateau gains Sandy Shocks in a repeated Claydol slot. Preserve Rockruff's distinct form, Girafarig and other useful visitors, and use actual ruins access for guide text.

changes.name: Route111_RuinsExterior
changes.rationale: The desert ruins gain the missing ancient magnet. Baltoy/Claydol remain in the desert and ruin interiors; no early player family is removed.

changes.acceptance: Reconcile configured species; preserve slot weights/levels and all other slots; ordinary-method chances >=5%; verify local encounter terrain/method access; check displaced-family remaining source before materializing.

MAP_ROUTE112.name: Route112
MAP_ROUTE112.assessment: Keep the hot mountain approach's Fighting/Fire roster and Tyrogue. An optional early Tyrogue gift is a separate proposal only if it preserves this wild habitat; no need to remove the current entry.

MAP_ROUTE113.name: Route113
MAP_ROUTE113.assessment: Spinda, Skarmory and Spoink establish ash-route nostalgia. Preserve the new competitive choices around those anchors and avoid duplicate relocation merely for apparent rarity.

MAP_ROUTE114.name: Route114
MAP_ROUTE114.assessment: Swablu, Lombre/Nuzleaf and Zangoose/Seviper retain identity with varied visiting families. Keep the mixed roster and the separate river/rock methods that reward return exploration.

MAP_ROUTE115.name: Route115
MAP_ROUTE115.assessment: The northern grass roster supports useful families but is not on the same initial path as southern Seaspray access. Preserve the species and explicitly separate those physical areas in guidance.

MAP_ROUTE116.name: Route116
MAP_ROUTE116.assessment: Nincada, Skitty and the recent babies coexist with strong unevolved choices and Dreepy. Preserve all of them; low-level late bloomers are valid player choices rather than a pacing defect.

MAP_ROUTE117.name: Route117
MAP_ROUTE117.assessment: The Daycare meadow stays broad with Ditto and varied mammals/plants. The Old Rod gains Paldean Wooper while retaining Tympole, adding a missing functional line without another scarce hunt.

changes.name: Route117
changes.rationale: The Daycare pond gains a mud-dwelling regional form and immediate Clodsire option. Keep Tympole as the other Old Rod species. Magikarp remains widely available from the earlier Dewford Old Rod.

MAP_ROUTE118.name: Route118
MAP_ROUTE118.assessment: Linoone/Manectric preserve the familiar river corridor. Replace redundant Raticate/Porygon occurrences with Galarian Zigzagoon and Squawkabilly; their displaced families retain actual other routes.

changes.name: Route118

changes.rationale: Add Blue Basculin and its different ability option through Route118 Super Rod; red Basculin remains on this route by Surf and elsewhere.

MAP_ROUTE119.name: Route119
MAP_ROUTE119.assessment: Tropius, Goomy and rainforest residents stay with Raging Bolt. Hisuian Voltorb replaces a repeated final-evolution Kommo-o encounter; its base family remains earlier and elsewhere.

changes.name: Route119
changes.rationale: The wet forest gains a wooden, Grass/Electric regional form. Jangmo-o remains on Route114/JaggedPass and can evolve before this cap; direct Kommo-o remains elsewhere.

MAP_ROUTE120.name: Route120
MAP_ROUTE120.assessment: Keep Absol, Tropius and the mushroom/pumpkin ecology. The four Pumpkaboo sizes are deliberate form access; do not call them four entirely new species or remove mechanically distinct size options.

MAP_ROUTE121.name: Route121
MAP_ROUTE121.assessment: The city/haunted-country transition gains Alolan Grimer in a repeated evolved Hypno slot. Early Drowzee preserves Hypno access; Komala also yields space for a directly obtainable rare Maushold form while remaining on Route118.

changes.name: Route121
changes.rationale: The Lilycove approach gains an imported urban scavenger and Alolan Muk path. Drowzee remains in early Dewford Manor, preserving Hypno through evolution.
changes.authoring_dependency: For Route117 fishing add a validated optional two-species old_rod_species override to the existing route sheet/builder; all other entries are native land-table edits.
changes.acceptance: Reconcile configured species; preserve slot weights/levels and all other slots; ordinary-method chances >=5%; verify local encounter terrain/method access; check displaced-family remaining source before materializing.

changes.name: Route121
changes.acceptance: Preserve all other slots/weights/levels; validate configured exact form, actual source access and retained displaced-family route.
changes.rationale: Provide the rare three-member Maushold directly at8% without requiring repeated PID hunts. Komala remains on Route118.

MAP_ROUTE122.name: Route122
MAP_ROUTE122.assessment: The haunted island's surrounding water has Frillish and deep marine choices. Preserve the coastal context and avoid counting island access as reaching every Mt.Pyre interior immediately.

MAP_ROUTE123.name: Route123
MAP_ROUTE123.assessment: The Berry Master's countryside supports plants, insects, birds and orchard families. Preserve Karrablast/Shelmet access, their evolution methods and the separate garden-currency rewards.

MAP_ROUTE124.name: Route124
MAP_ROUTE124.assessment: The eastern sea offers Finizen, Mantine and useful rod catches. Retain the distinctive Dive layer rather than treating its surface and underwater species as one pool.

MAP_ROUTE125.name: Route125
MAP_ROUTE125.assessment: The cold approach to Shoal supports Spheal and marine options. Keep its rod-only Hisuian Qwilfish and the indoor tide-related discoveries distinct.

MAP_ROUTE126.name: Route126
MAP_ROUTE126.assessment: The Sootopolis perimeter has its own sea population and an underwater layer. Preserve the two as separate habitats with Dive requirements and appropriate story access.

MAP_ROUTE127.name: Route127
MAP_ROUTE127.assessment: The eastern approach provides Lapras, Mareanie and other marine tools near demanding trainers. Keep the accessible choices and the Keldeo-related landmark separate from fishing.

MAP_ROUTE128.name: Route128
MAP_ROUTE128.assessment: The cavern approach retains Wailmer, Sharpedo and strong marine combinations. Preserve Finizen and the distinct Seafloor/Dive entrances rather than flattening all acquisition into this route.

MAP_ROUTE129.name: Route129
MAP_ROUTE129.assessment: The southern ocean offers cold/deep visitors and special fishing forms. Keep the current roster while linking current-direction constraints to actual exploration.

MAP_ROUTE130.name: Route130
MAP_ROUTE130.assessment: Wynaut remains the leading Mirage Island resident. Preserve broad optional island diversity under the user's choice-first direction, while explicitly distinguishing rare island appearance from species slot chance.

MAP_ROUTE131.name: Route131
MAP_ROUTE131.assessment: Clamperl and Gyarados make a useful southern-water mix near Sky Pillar. Keep the Super Rod and Surf split and the story-controlled tower entrance separate.

MAP_ROUTE132.name: Route132
MAP_ROUTE132.assessment: Current-driven water exploration offers Wailmer/Finizen and different fish. Preserve usable catches and document one-way current access and return routes.

MAP_ROUTE133.name: Route133
MAP_ROUTE133.assessment: The currents include Spheal, Mantine and Lapras options. Preserve convenient collection rather than forcing repeated long current loops for an exclusive critical counter.

MAP_ROUTE134.name: Route134
MAP_ROUTE134.assessment: The Sealed Chamber approach keeps deep-sea residents and useful fishing forms. Its puzzle prerequisites belong to the landmark path, not every ordinary encounter in the surrounding water.

MAP_RUSTURF_TUNNEL.name: RusturfTunnel
MAP_RUSTURF_TUNNEL.assessment: Whismur has the top slot and is uniquely associated with this tunnel; retain broad early alternatives including Chingling, Larvitar and Bagon. The prior suggestion to sacrifice this ammunition for a narrow roster is not adopted.

MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_NORTH.name: SafariZone_North
MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_NORTH.assessment: Imported regional forms, Kangaskhan, Tauros and Scyther make a strong collection destination. Preserve the roster and actual bike-area access; normal species collection remains distinct from the nursery Mega reward.

MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_NORTHEAST.name: SafariZone_Northeast
MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_NORTHEAST.assessment: The extension's familiar Johto and evolved species remain useful postgame alternatives. Clearly record the extension opening rather than treating all Safari sections as immediately accessible.

MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_NORTHWEST.name: SafariZone_Northwest
MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_NORTHWEST.assessment: The more developed Safari population complements the northern section and includes Ditto. Preserve Kangaskhan/Scyther access and all water-method distinctions; a redundant Ditto occurrence yields space for the Yellow Squawkabilly ability group.

changes.name: SafariZone_Northwest
changes.acceptance: Preserve all other slots/weights/levels; validate configured exact form, actual source access and retained displaced-family route.
changes.rationale: Add the Yellow Squawkabilly ability group to the imported-fauna destination. Ditto remains accessible much earlier on Route117 and other Safari sections.

MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_SOUTH.name: SafariZone_South
MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_SOUTH.assessment: The accessible imported-fauna section gains Galarian Meowth instead of repeated Porygon. Keep Alolan cats/Raichu, Chansey and the recognizable Safari collection mix.

changes.name: SafariZone_South
changes.rationale: The imported-fauna collection gains the missing Galarian Meowth/Perrserker line. New Mauville retains Porygon at the same Surf access tier.

MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_SOUTHEAST.name: SafariZone_Southeast
MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_SOUTHEAST.assessment: The extension supports evolved Johto choices and special water methods. Preserve it as additional convenience without claiming the expansion gate is already open pre-League.

MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_SOUTHWEST.name: SafariZone_Southwest
MAP_SAFARI_ZONE_SOUTHWEST.assessment: Swamp insects, Croagunk and Goomy families provide a coherent alternative Safari ecosystem. Keep their evolved catches and independent fishing choices.

MAP_SANDSTREWN_RUINS.name: SandstrewnRuins
MAP_SANDSTREWN_RUINS.assessment: Relic Ghost/Steel Pokémon and Great Tusk make an appropriate archaeological reward. Preserve unusual power and distinguish puzzle navigation from simple map registration.

MAP_SANDSTREWN_RUINS_2F.name: SandstrewnRuins_2F
MAP_SANDSTREWN_RUINS_2F.assessment: Iron Treads distinguishes this excavated floor while repeated Claydol remains nearby. Preserve the remaining relic residents and all Rock Smash entries.

changes.name: SandstrewnRuins_2F
changes.rationale: Add a missing mechanical excavator to a ruin excavation floor. Claydol remains on adjacent ruin floors and can be evolved from Baltoy.
changes.authoring_dependency: For Route117 fishing add a validated optional two-species old_rod_species override to the existing route sheet/builder; all other entries are native land-table edits.

MAP_SANDSTREWN_RUINS_3F.name: SandstrewnRuins_3F
MAP_SANDSTREWN_RUINS_3F.assessment: Evolved relics and Doublade fit the higher chamber. Keep the strategic variety; final access depends on the actual sequence of warps and obstacles.

MAP_SANDSTREWN_RUINS_B1F.name: SandstrewnRuins_B1F
MAP_SANDSTREWN_RUINS_B1F.assessment: Stakataka and Aegislash make the deep ruin distinctive. Preserve both powerful options with their different acquisition/capture-state rules.

MAP_SCORCHED_SLAB_B1F.name: ScorchedSlab_B1F
MAP_SCORCHED_SLAB_B1F.assessment: The hot cave combines Fighting support, dragons and Fire types. Preserve the varied roster and separate water methods; the slab's expansion route is part of its identity.

MAP_SCORCHED_SLAB_B2F.name: ScorchedSlab_B2F
MAP_SCORCHED_SLAB_B2F.assessment: Iron Moth replaces redundant Slugma to give the deeper hot chamber a missing exceptional species. Preserve Fire/Dragon residents and the separate Reshiram landmark.

changes.name: ScorchedSlab_B2F
changes.rationale: A missing artificial fire insect distinguishes the hot deep slab. Slugma remains at Fiery Path and multiple neighboring volcanic sites.
changes.authoring_dependency: For Route117 fishing add a validated optional two-species old_rod_species override to the existing route sheet/builder; all other entries are native land-table edits.

MAP_SCORCHED_SLAB_HEATRANS_ROOM.name: ScorchedSlab_HeatransRoom
MAP_SCORCHED_SLAB_HEATRANS_ROOM.assessment: The furnace roster and Heatran interaction fit the room. Keep physical-reveal and capture states distinct; the misleading name of a flag alone is not a defect.

MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ENTRANCE.name: SeafloorCavern_Entrance
MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ENTRANCE.assessment: Keep ordinary marine preparation at the entrance while Dive, the submarine and later cavern rooms remain distinct. Fishing rewards do not imply the story boulder route is open.

MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM1.name: SeafloorCavern_Room1
MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM1.assessment: Marine predators and a cave resident make the room feel submerged. Preserve its varied offensive choices and its independent authored trainer encounter.

MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM2.name: SeafloorCavern_Room2
MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM2.assessment: Sharpedo/Floatzel and deep-water bruisers distinguish this branch. Keep Basculegion and the cave bat rather than require one prescribed anti-Aqua team.

MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM3.name: SeafloorCavern_Room3
MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM3.assessment: Dhelmise, relic Pokémon and defensive Water types fit the enclosed ruin. Preserve the palette and the nearby admin battle as separate content.

MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM4.name: SeafloorCavern_Room4
MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM4.assessment: Keep Sharpedo, Malamar and the mixed marine offense. Its local cave geometry and partner-safe player options deserve preservation.

MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM5.name: SeafloorCavern_Room5
MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM5.assessment: Tynamo and deep-water attackers distinguish the darker chamber. Retain the strong choices and the range of physical/special preparation roles.

MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM6.name: SeafloorCavern_Room6
MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM6.assessment: The land roster and flooded section are separate encounter methods. Preserve both and document the current puzzle so players can actually reach the advertised water.

MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM7.name: SeafloorCavern_Room7
MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM7.assessment: The defensive marine mix complements the adjacent water pool. Keep Toxapex, Golisopod and useful specialists rather than reduce the cave to repeated Zubat.

MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM8.name: SeafloorCavern_Room8
MAP_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN_ROOM8.assessment: The final approach retains capable marine Pokémon plus Clobbopus/Dewpider options. Preserve the breadth immediately before Archie's demanding battle.

MAP_SEASPRAY_CAVE.name: Seaspray_Cave
MAP_SEASPRAY_CAVE.assessment: The early side cave supplies aquatic, Ground and unusual resistance options. Keep its current broad access; do not assume Rock Smash objects block every route to the lower floor.

MAP_SEASPRAY_CAVE_B1F.name: Seaspray_Cave_B1F
MAP_SEASPRAY_CAVE_B1F.assessment: Preserve the early Ice roster, babies and Frigibax. The user's choice-first direction supersedes a blanket plan to move these families later merely to reserve Shoal's novelty.

MAP_SHOAL_CAVE_LOW_TIDE_ENTRANCE_ROOM.name: ShoalCave_LowTideEntranceRoom
MAP_SHOAL_CAVE_LOW_TIDE_ENTRANCE_ROOM.assessment: Spheal/Snorunt and familiar cave residents establish the cold habitat. Keep its water and fishing layer and explain tide access through actual map state.

MAP_SHOAL_CAVE_LOW_TIDE_ICE_ROOM.name: ShoalCave_LowTideIceRoom
MAP_SHOAL_CAVE_LOW_TIDE_ICE_ROOM.assessment: Alolan Vulpix, Hisuian Sneasel, Iron Bundle and distinct forms give the room fresh value despite earlier Ice access. Preserve its meaningful discoveries and Mega rewards.

MAP_SHOAL_CAVE_LOW_TIDE_INNER_ROOM.name: ShoalCave_LowTideInnerRoom
MAP_SHOAL_CAVE_LOW_TIDE_INNER_ROOM.assessment: Galarian Darumaka replaces the repeated bat while original cold residents remain. Preserve water-method catches and the return route under tide changes.

changes.name: ShoalCave_LowTideInnerRoom
changes.rationale: Introduce the missing Galarian Darumaka branch while bats remain at the entrance and other caves. Preserve Spheal/Snorunt and the existing water population.

MAP_SHOAL_CAVE_LOW_TIDE_LOWER_ROOM.name: ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom
MAP_SHOAL_CAVE_LOW_TIDE_LOWER_ROOM.assessment: Alolan Sandshrew replaces a repeated Seel occurrence, adding a missing Ice/Steel choice. Spheal/Snorunt and the remaining roster preserve the cave's signature.

changes.name: ShoalCave_LowTideLowerRoom

MAP_SHOAL_CAVE_LOW_TIDE_STAIRS_ROOM.name: ShoalCave_LowTideStairsRoom
MAP_SHOAL_CAVE_LOW_TIDE_STAIRS_ROOM.assessment: The connecting cold roster supports convenient collection across the tide route. Keep Arctibax and core Ice families; a connecting room need not invent another exclusive species.

MAP_SKY_PILLAR_1F.name: SkyPillar_1F
MAP_SKY_PILLAR_1F.assessment: Ancient Ghosts, minerals and dragons support the tower's identity. Preserve the ready team options and the distinction between first story ascent and later exploration conditions.

MAP_SKY_PILLAR_3F.name: SkyPillar_3F
MAP_SKY_PILLAR_3F.assessment: Mature dragons and Metagross make the tower a valuable preparation destination. Preserve variety and verify actual bike/transition access before assigning an earliest capture cap.

MAP_SKY_PILLAR_5F.name: SkyPillar_5F
MAP_SKY_PILLAR_5F.assessment: The upper roster offers powerful final-team choices beneath Rayquaza. Keep those encounters separate from the scripted legendary's visibility/retry state.

MAP_SLATEPORT_CITY.name: SlateportCity
MAP_SLATEPORT_CITY.assessment: The port's coastal methods complement its early NPC/gift interactions. Preserve the broad return roster and avoid treating its high authored water levels as early-game accessibility.

MAP_SOOTOPOLIS_CITY.name: SootopolisCity
MAP_SOOTOPOLIS_CITY.assessment: The crater lake retains its own Water roster and Finizen/Gyarados options. Story weather suppression and access to the town are separate conditions from catching after the crisis.

MAP_UNDERWATER_ROUTE124.name: Underwater_Route124
MAP_UNDERWATER_ROUTE124.assessment: Preserve Dondozo and the deep, developed marine population. This is a real Dive reward rather than a reason to move useful surface species out of the game.

MAP_UNDERWATER_ROUTE126.name: Underwater_Route126
MAP_UNDERWATER_ROUTE126.assessment: Clamperl's branches, Relicanth, Milotic and other deep residents make this underwater pocket distinct. Keep its variation and actual grass/terrain encounter access.

MAP_UNDERWATER_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN.name: Underwater_SeafloorCavern
MAP_UNDERWATER_SEAFLOOR_CAVERN.assessment: Dondozo/Tatsugiri remain the signature discovery. Add Droopy and Stretchy variants in redundant Kingdra/Wishiwashi slots while retaining each form at least5% and the submarine-only association.

changes.name: Underwater_SeafloorCavern
changes.acceptance: Preserve all other slots/weights/levels; validate configured exact form, actual source access and retained displaced-family route.
changes.rationale: Make Droopy Tatsugiri independently obtainable at8% beside Dondozo; Kingdra remains in other underwater and cavern tables.

changes.name: Underwater_SeafloorCavern
changes.acceptance: Preserve all other slots/weights/levels; validate configured exact form, actual source access and retained displaced-family route.
changes.rationale: Make Stretchy Tatsugiri independently obtainable at6% beside Dondozo; Wishiwashi remains in many earlier sea/fishing tables.

MAP_VERDANTURF_MEADOW.name: VerdanturfMeadow
MAP_VERDANTURF_MEADOW.assessment: Keep Cottonee, Deerling and the unusual Fairy/Psychic roster. Redundant evolved forms yield Galarian Ponyta and Iron Leaves; a separate hospitality gift supplies Indeedee-F without deleting the male form.

MAP_VICTORY_ROAD_1F.name: VictoryRoad_1F
MAP_VICTORY_ROAD_1F.assessment: Preserve the mature final-team roster and first-floor Iron Valiant. Late acquisition should be immediately usable through the Leveler and preparation services.

MAP_VICTORY_ROAD_B1F.name: VictoryRoad_B1F
MAP_VICTORY_ROAD_B1F.assessment: Iron Jugulis replaces one repeated Noibat to distinguish the middle floor. Keep every other pseudo-legendary and advanced option rather than mandate raising a new team from scratch.

changes.name: VictoryRoad_B1F
changes.rationale: The middle Victory Road floor gains a distinct late opponent-building option. Noibat remains from Rusturf onward and on the other Victory Road floors.

MAP_VICTORY_ROAD_B2F.name: VictoryRoad_B2F
MAP_VICTORY_ROAD_B2F.assessment: The deepest route retains final-team power and a separate water layer. Preserve its roster and the League handoff; repeated useful families are acceptable here.
